item.title: High school boys basketball: Mount Academy wraps up MHAL Division IV title with win
item.description: RHINEBECK, N.Y. — Mount Academy’s boys basketball team claimed the title in Division IV of the Mid-Hudson Athletic League (MHAL) with a 45-37 victory over Rhinebeck on Friday, Jan. 30. item.description: NEWBURGH, N.Y. — Sophomore guard Kallie McCoy scored a game-high 31 points as host Newburgh Free Academy’s girls basketball team snapped Kingston’s seven-game win streak with a 63-60 Orange County Interscholastic Athletic Association (OCIAA) Division 1 victory on Friday, Jan. 30.
